## Status and final proof target

**Collatz remains OPEN.** This pass builds smaller ordinary queries, proves limits on several proposed universal search mechanisms, and assembles all proved cases into a final Lean proposal. The theorem `collatz_from_remaining` has the explicit input `RemainingExclusion`; that input is still unproved.

Published head: `10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a`  
Exact tree: `277bfc8346716d4c01088f617eeb49b947239aa9`

[Scientific packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/README.md) · [Final Lean proposal](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/ClosingProposal.lean) · [Execution and independent reviews](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/README.md)

## Why this continuation is needed

The remaining problem is progress at the same supplied ordinary least reverse defect. A construction on a different large input, a finite residue population, or a long merging block shifted far up a tower does not supply that progress. Three GPT-6.2 Astra delegates at ultra effort attacked complementary source-specific constructions and then independently reviewed one another's results.

## New proved results

- **Rational-reference descent into the difficult rank-three row.** Thirteen full progressions exclude **17 parameter classes of m modulo 19,683** in the family `j=11+162m, 81z+271=2^(j+7)`. Each gives a positive smaller residue-17 query whose lower arm actually meets the original lower orbit and whose triple reaches a power of two. The parameter classes are for m, not j. [Lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/MersenneTwoCenter.lean)
- **All-rank finite residue exclusion.** Sixteen literal word certificates exclude 55 of the 256 candidate classes modulo 12,288. Five use an additional tripling query only at a proved smaller candidate. [Lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/GuardedResidueCover.lean)
- **Paired ordinary affine reductions.** Common and distinct signed references give exact basin-label transport and smaller queries, including the distinct references -1807 and -127 with displacement ratio 3/64. [Proof and scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/SIGNED_ROUTES.md)
- **Exact pointwise clock restrictions.** The kernel proves the small convergence floor and both 1024-clock equivalences. A least reverse defect has at least 621 odd inputs by clock 1024 and satisfies an explicit inequality at every clock. [Lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/OddClockFloor.lean) · [Least-defect consumer](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/DefectClockFloor.lean)
- **No deadline depending only on upper rank.** For every fixed upper first-hit odd count R>=3, every clock deadline and every size cutoff, a single ordinary source has that rank while postponing the required forward drop beyond the deadline. These examples are not asserted nonconvergent. [Lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/FixedRankDeadlines.lean)
- **An all-clock limit of the rational-center language.** At the convergent parent 3233, none of the 67 smaller eligible queries ever visits any of the twelve available lower phases. A separate written cofinal theorem requires increasing denominator depth or at least twelve extra lower odd inputs. [Lean kernel](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/CenterPhaseObstruction.lean) · [Written transfer and scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/CENTER_PHASE_OBSTRUCTION.md)
- **Exact checkpoint exits and stronger comparison limits.** Lean proves both normalized exits and their earlier-Mersenne attachments. Separately reviewed written theorems give simultaneous delay and show that a 32-trajectory comparison menu reduces, within the stated windows, to the two matching-degree comparisons. Selected supplied sources merge; no merger is guaranteed for every fixed cofactor. [Checkpoint proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/SIMULTANEOUS_CHECKPOINT_DELAY.md) · [32-comparator theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/THIRTY_TWO_ORDINARY_COMPARISONS.md)

The finite class counts are not percentages of Collatz solved. The full integer-reference, denominator-transfer, simultaneous-delay and 32-comparator arguments retain their stated written-proof scope; they are not all relabeled as Lean theorems.

## Latest repository and literature synthesis

The first intake read forty recent open PRs and inspected 42 exact source files at four changed relevant heads. A second live refresh found new PR192, PR195 and PR206 heads; each received an exact-source review before publication.

PR206 now proves shifted merging blocks on **every prescribed odd tower**, not only on selected bases. Its 513-rank common endpoint lies below the first shifted vertex; recurrence of a rank-zero basin disagreement inside that later block remains open. PR192's new height slice does not cover either difficult row at its required threshold. PR195's full-denominator tests still require exclusion of every admissible nontrivial word. [Live synthesis and source pins](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/LIVE_SOURCE_SYNTHESIS.md)

The Aaronson–Yolcu–Heule mixed-base rewriting work and a newly inspected primary matrix-barrier source inform the choice of ordinary paired queries. The external barrier Lean project was not rebuilt or imported as an assumption. [Source ledger](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/SOURCES.json)

## Verification actually performed

- **41 mathematical modules and three audit modules rebuilt from source**, with twelve new mathematical modules. Four recorded batches contain 49 successful compiler invocations, including five final recompiles after three trailing-whitespace removals.
- Lean **4.34.1**, compiler commit `5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52`; Mathlib `d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612`.
- Flags `-j1 -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true`. No author-supplied local objects were reused.
- Exhaustive public audit: **204 distinct theorem declarations, 52 new**. Dependencies are subsets of `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. The explicit open proposition is an argument, not an added axiom.
- Six finite checkers each passed normally and with Python optimization, with matching outputs. Independent direct-integer reconstruction includes all thirteen new progressions at two members apiece.
- Final local and GitHub tree IDs matched exactly; the remote head was independently re-read. The published commit was fetched into a clean complete checkout.
- `python -X utf8 -B tools/validate.py` ran on **this published commit**, and all five default commands exited zero. This is repository-integrity evidence, separate from mathematical verification.

[Detailed execution and review record](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/README.md) · [Final source hashes](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/source-hashes.json) · [Prior PR description preserved](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/paired-reductions/PRIOR_PR_DESCRIPTION.json)

## First unsupported mathematical step

Prove `RemainingExclusion` for every surviving least reverse defect: the same source must admit ordinary progress without an unproved upper-rank, clock, denominator-depth or finite-bank cutoff. The final Lean equivalence isolates that requirement and does not prove it.

This remains a draft research PR.
